title: Port Vesper
verdict: A seaside city that feels like a finished small game: a boardwalk with a Ferris wheel pier, a park, a plaza and container docks, busy with traffic and people, with four working activities and the best lighting of the three.

city.note: About twenty blocks with eight building types, shopfronts and signs, plus a park, a plaza, a beach promenade with a pier, and docks with stunt ramps.

character.note: Jointed figure with knees and elbows; walks, runs, jumps and tumbles, and kicks loose props. Solid against everything tried.

vehicles.note: Seven car models, any of them takeable whether parked or moving (checked by taking a patrol car). Slides, handbrake drifts and ramp jumps. Got wedged on street furniture once.

world.note: 55 AI drivers that stop at working traffic lights and 60 pedestrians who cross at corners and dodge cars.

hud.note: Rotating minimap with job blips, speedometer with gear, cash, heat stars, and an objective panel with distance, bearing and timer.

gameplay.note: Three-parcel courier run paid $740 when completed; nine-gate street sprint started; stealing a patrol car raised heat to 2. Also taxi shifts and 24 tokens.

atmosphere.note: Day and night with clouds, sea, shadows, bloom, neon signs and lit windows after dark. Sound and radio are in the code but were not listened to.
